title: ChatGPT aapke sawaal ka jawab kaise banata hai?
hooks: Jab aap ChatGPT se kuch poochte ho, to wo poora jawab ek saath nahi sochta.
ChatGPT itni lambi baatein bina ruke kaise likh leta hai?
Aapka sawal bhejte hi computer ke andar kya chalta hai?
hook_why: Contrarian hook that busts the biggest myth about LLMs right in the first sentence: people assume AI thinks out a whole sentence, but it actually builds it piece by piece.
metaphor: A superfast puzzle-solver robot predicting and snapping the single next puzzle block onto a glowing sentence track.

cast.typewriter_bot: A cute glossy 3D navy-and-brass robot typewriter character with big expressive glowing cyan eyes, rounded edges, and tiny metallic mechanical arms, in a dark navy studio with soft blue rim light and warm yellow accent #ffd84d

scenes.vo: Jab aap ChatGPT se kuch poochte ho, to wo poora jawab ek saath nahi sochta.
scenes.prompt: Glossy 3D Pixar-style dark navy studio, soft blue rim light, warm yellow accent #ffd84d. In center, typewriter_bot stares curiously at a giant glowing holographic question mark, glowing cyan eyes blinking softly, clean studio composition, no text.

scenes.vo: Wo har second sirf agla ek akshar ya shabd guess karta hai.
scenes.prompt: Glossy 3D Pixar-style dark navy studio, soft blue rim light. typewriter_bot holding up a single glossy glowing yellow puzzle cube in its mechanical hand, inspecting it with focused bright eyes, dark clean background, no text.

scenes.vo: Bilkul aapke phone ke auto-complete ki tarah, par laakhon guna zyada tez.
scenes.prompt: Glossy 3D Pixar-style dark navy studio, soft blue rim light, yellow accent #ffd84d. Stylized floating vertical glass smartphone with three glowing cyan blank prediction capsules hovering above a sleek illuminated keypad plate, no text.

scenes.vo: Sabse pehle aapka sawal chhote tukdon mein kat-ta hai, jinhe tokens kehte hain.
scenes.prompt: Glossy 3D Pixar-style dark navy studio, soft blue rim light. A glowing beam of light slicing into translucent cyan and yellow cubic glass blocks that gently drift in mid-air, casting soft reflections, no text.

scenes.vo: Har token ek number banta hai, taaki computer use samajh sake.
scenes.prompt: Dark navy studio diagram style, glowing cyan geometric shapes converting into bright golden pulses flowing across clean illuminated circuit tracks, no text.

scenes.vo: Is AI ne internet ki arbon kitabein aur baatein pehle se padhi hain.
scenes.prompt: Glossy 3D Pixar-style dark navy studio, soft blue rim light. Vast curved cylindrical archive walls glowing with millions of tiny illuminated crystal blocks, typewriter_bot standing on a floating navy platform admiring the scale, no text.

scenes.vo: Toh jaise hi aap likhte ho: Chanda mama door ke...
scenes.prompt: Glossy 3D Pixar-style dark navy studio, soft blue rim light. typewriter_bot taps a round illuminated key on its chest; three glowing blue rectangular blocks snap into place one after another on an open metallic track, no text.

scenes.vo: To iska calculation kehta hai ki agla shabd puye hone ka chance sabse zyada hai.
scenes.prompt: Glossy 3D Pixar-style dark navy studio, soft blue rim light, yellow accent. A sleek glowing circular probability dial pointing toward a brightly lit peak sector beside an empty slot on a glowing track, no text.

scenes.vo: Aur wo agla shabd fit karte hi, poori line dobara padhta hai.
scenes.prompt: Glossy 3D Pixar-style dark navy studio. typewriter_bot fits a golden cube into the empty rail slot, while an instant cyan scanning laser beam sweeps back across the entire assembled row of blocks, no text.

scenes.vo: Yahi process second mein hazaron baar chalta hai, isliye typing bilkul live lagti hai.
scenes.prompt: Glossy 3D Pixar-style dark navy studio. A rapid domino wave of glowing blocks locking into a sleek illuminated sentence path, camera tracking forward as typewriter_bot watches happily, no text.

scenes.vo: Aapko kya laga tha, AI sach mein sochta hai ya bas probability ka khel hai? Batao!
scenes.prompt: Glossy 3D Pixar-style dark navy studio, soft blue rim light, warm yellow accent #ffd84d. typewriter_bot leaning forward towards camera with wide curious cyan eyes, gesturing with open metallic palms, asking a question, no text.

caption: ChatGPT poora jawab ek baar mein nahi sochta! Wo har second agla sabse logical shabd calculate karta hai. 🤖⚡

claims.claim: LLMs split input text into chunks called tokens and convert them to numeric representations.
claims.basis: Standard Large Language Model transformer architecture documentation (Vaswani et al., OpenAI technical papers).

claims.claim: ChatGPT generates text autoregressively by predicting the most probable next token given prior context.
claims.basis: Autoregressive language modeling mechanism in Generative Pre-trained Transformers.

claims.claim: The model calculates probabilities based on statistical patterns learned during pretraining on large text corpora.
claims.basis: OpenAI GPT-3 / GPT-4 foundation architecture research.
